detail.title: Thunder 1000 (S) (17003) - 100W Tower Speaker
detail.overview: Enhance your audio experience with the Intex Thunder 1000 (S) (17003). With a 100W power output and an 8-inch woofer, it delivers deep bass and crystal-clear sound. The multimode playability supports Bluetooth, USB, AUX, FM, and MIC for versatile connectivity. Featuring a wired MIC jack with a voice priority function, it is perfect for karaoke and events. The LED display, triple digital dynamic bass, and analogue controls for volume, bass, and treble make it a must-have speaker for any occasion.
features: 100W powerful sound output for an immersive audio experience
8-inch (20.3 cm) woofer for deep bass and enhanced clarity
Multimode playability: Bluetooth, USB, AUX, FM, and MIC
Wired MIC jack with voice priority function for karaoke and announcements
Triple digital & dynamic bass for a richer sound experience
Informative LED display for easy navigation
300% faster instant connection for uninterrupted music playback
USB support for up to 64GB storage
Analogue controls for volume, bass, and treble adjustments
